title: Implement Robust Error Handling Middleware
description: This feature matters because it will provide a standardized way to handle errors in the framework, improving overall reliability and user experience. It will catch and log errors, returning user-friendly error messages. This will also help with debugging and issue tracking.
testCases: Test error handling for synchronous errors
Test error handling for asynchronous errors
acceptance: Error handling middleware should catch and log errors, returning a user-friendly error message with a 500 status code. Error logs should include the error message, status code, and request information.
reason: Implementing robust error handling is crucial for a production-ready framework, as it directly impacts the user experience and helps with debugging and issue tracking.
